## History

As a three-year-old, Minnie May suffered a severe case of croup that left her feverish and breathing hoarsely. While her mother was away, she fell ill through the night, prompting her sister [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to seek help at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) used her past experience with children to successfully treat Minnie May until a doctor arrived, an effort that ultimately led to Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) forgiving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P25](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0025), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--minnie-may.md)

Minnie May's life was saved by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) when she fell critically ill with severe croup while her mother was away. Drawing on her past experience caring for young children, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) managed to treat Minnie May throughout the night until a doctor could arrive. This life-saving intervention caused Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) to forgive [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and allow her to resume her friendship with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P25](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0025), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), +1 more_
